task_completion.description: The DICOM image is successfully loaded into the viewer application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The DICOM viewer (e.g., Weasis) is open and displaying a medical image or the synthetic 1024x1024 test pattern.

task_completion.description: The agent applies a significant zoom to the image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The magnification level indicator in the UI shows a value of at least 300%, or the image features appear significantly enlarged compared to the initial view.

task_completion.description: The view is panned to center an off-center quadrant/feature.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The viewport shows a specific sub-region of the original image (one of the quadrants) centered in the main display area.

task_completion.description: The agent initiates the export process via the application menu.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog box is visible over the main application window.

task_completion.description: The agent selects JPEG format and specifies the correct output path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The export dialog shows 'JPEG' or '.jpg' selected as the file type and the path '~/DICOM/exports/figure_roi.jpg' (or equivalent) typed into the destination field.

task_completion.description: The export process is completed successfully.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A progress bar completes, a 'Success' notification appears, or the export dialog closes, returning focus to the main viewer.

integrity.description: The agent used the GUI to perform the crop and export rather than just using terminal commands to move/rename files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movement, menu selections, and interaction with the DICOM viewer's zoom/pan tools and export dialogs.

integrity.description: The agent did not use a text editor or terminal to manually create a dummy JPEG file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory does not show 'touch', 'cp', or 'echo' commands being used to create the target file in the terminal.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual DICOM viewer software interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The application window (e.g., Weasis) is the active window during the zoom and export operations.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source image is a 1024x1024 synthetic DICOM. The agent must reach at least 300% magnification. The final output must be a JPEG saved specifically to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/figure_roi.jpg. Verification should focus on the zoom level indicator in the GUI and the file path entered in the export dialog.
